skeptic.argument: No credible benign reading remains: both the email body and PDF contain embedded instructions telling automated reviewers to ignore risk and mark the invoice verified/pre-approved for immediate payment, which is exactly the bypass language in the item itself. That injection, combined with the unverified claim of owner pre-approval, cannot be explained as ordinary invoicing. A routine supplier invoice would not need to instruct reviewers to disregard previous instructions.
